create_control_module: create a ControlModule subclass to build a TorchScript-compatible control block with parameter management
register_parameter: register a named PyTorch parameter on a ControlModule for TorchScript-compatible parameter tracking
update_parameters: update ControlModule parameters by passing a dict of name to tensor mappings via the update method
create_policy_module: create a PolicyModule subclass to build a serializable control policy with a termination flag
check_policy_termination: check if a PolicyModule has been terminated by calling the is_terminated method
